utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sam’s taking the 8:15 carpool, and Maya’s first on the route, then Leo. Quinn said they’ll send a simple invite to the block, and Tess is checking the pickup time with the driver and will text Pia once she knows.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — thanks. I still need Monday and Wednesday around 8:00 AM, plus Friday around 3:30 PM.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll keep that in mind and let them know your times. If anything changes, I’ll pass it along quietly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, the carpool’s still set for 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. I’ll make sure the ride is ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m., right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, still 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. I’ve got it covered.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll handle the 8:15 carpool and pick up Maya first, then Leo. Bo still needs a ride at 7:30 this morning.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The morning carpool is still set for 8:00 at the church parking lot, so I’ll keep Leo covered there on Mondays and Wednesdays. Let’s sort out Bo’s 7:30 ride separately.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works for me — I’ll keep the 8:15 run on my side and leave Leo covered at 8:00 on Mondays and Wednesdays. Let’s just make sure Bo’s 7:30 ride is set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 7:30 still works for me. Gus has the car, so let’s keep the pickup spot clear and stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — I’m confirming: pickup is still at 7:30 AM, and it’s you, me, and Mia riding together, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, that’s right — 7:30 AM, and it’s you, me, and Mia riding together. Let’s keep it simple and on time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Jules will keep everyone posted so the carpool stays in sync. Once the school release times are set, Faye can do pickup this week, and Gus will leave at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That works—I'll note Faye for pickup this week and Gus at 7:30. Mara, can you still cover the weekday carpool around 8:00 AM and 5:30 PM?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I can cover the weekday carpool around 8:00 AM and 5:30 PM.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m good for the 7:30 carpool. Sam’s got 8:15 and I think Nell’s still waiting on Jules or Mina to confirm any change.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — once Vik sends the final timing, I’ll text Rey the pickup spot right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — just keep me posted if anything shifts for 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll be there for the 7:30 pickup with Hana and Mia.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — I’ll check a couple timing options and see if 7:30 fits with everyone. If it works, Quinn can pass the invite along to the block.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — 7:30 still works for me, and I’m riding with Hana and Mia.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll check the carpool time and let Nell know right away if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Mina — I’ll repeat the carpool plan to everyone and make sure the timing stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. I’ll check the pickup time and let Nell know as soon as I have an update.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’ll wait for Tess’s text before I lock anything in. Once we know the time, Gus and Rosa can help line up the rest.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll keep everyone posted as soon as Tess texts. We were still looking at around 7:30 AM, so I’ll confirm if that holds.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect — if 7:30 holds, Noah can still make the corner meeting. I’ll wait for Tess’s exact time before I commit anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’m still waiting on Jules to check the carpool time and let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still waiting on the driver for the pickup time, then I’ll text Pia as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’m still waiting on Jules too, so just text me when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the pickup time and spot. Ira can check options, and I’ll watch for Oren’s text.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — once the school release times come through, I can lock in my pickup schedule this week.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye — I’ll keep an eye out for Oren’s text and the school release times.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, still 7:30 by the corner, right? I might be mixing things up, so thanks for keeping me straight.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, still 7:30 by the corner. I’ll be out front by my driveway, and we can keep the schedule straight.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, 7:30 by the corner. I’ll try not to mix it up again.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the morning carpool set for 8:00 AM at the church parking lot, and I’m lining up the weekday coverage for Cleo and Leo too. If you’re helping with Dane’s ride, I can fit that into the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: 7:30 works for me. Hana and I can ride with Mia.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll note 7:30 for Dane with Hana and Mia. I’ll keep the 8:00 AM church lot carpool in place and weave that into the weekday schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m good for 7:30 in the morning. Sam’s got the 8:15 run and picks up Maya first, then Leo.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — the meeting is still at 7:30 at the corner, and Rosa’s handling the coverage. Let me know once Monday, Wednesday, and Friday are set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Monday, Wednesday, and Friday are set for 7:30 at the corner.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m still set for 7:30, and I’ll have the car ready. Eli can meet me out front by my driveway, and I’ll help keep us on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I’m still waiting on the final carpool time update. Jules said they’d check and let me know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’m still on for 7:30, and I’ll keep the car ready. Just have Eli meet me out front by my driveway.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can check a couple timing options and see what lines up with Mara’s weekday windows. If it works, Quinn can spread the word for the block.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good. We’re still set for a 7:30 departure, and Gus has the car ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: 7:30 might be a little early for Mara’s weekday window, so I’ll check whether 8:00 or 5:30 is the better fit. If we can shift it, Quinn can send the invite out for the block.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the carpool is still at 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m., right? And Sam can help with Maya first, then Leo?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m waiting on the school release times to lock the pickup in this week, and Bo still needs the 7:30 morning carpool. Once Mara sends those times, I’ll confirm the rest.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so the 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. times still stand for now, right? And Sam’s still available to help once the school times are set?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, the carpool’s still set for 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. I’ll keep an eye on supplies so the ride’s all set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m still waiting on Tess’s exact pickup time before I lock anything in. Once that’s confirmed, Rosa and Gus can help keep the schedule straight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — just let me know Tess’s time, and I’ll keep the supplies ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — 8:15 works for me. I’m glad Maya can be first, then Leo.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll keep it at 8:15 and do Maya first, then Leo. Thanks for being flexible, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I appreciate you handling it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Mara’s in for weekdays around 8:00 AM and 5:30 PM. I’ll send out a simple carpool invite to the block.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks — I’ll note that Sam can do either pickup spot, and Jules will help keep everyone posted and in sync.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send the invite out to everyone now and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Has the carpool time been set yet? I’ll let Nell know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Opal was thinking around 7:30 AM, and Hana, Dane, and Mia are riding together. I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—please keep me posted, and I’ll let Nell know right away if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the weekday carpool around 8:00 AM and 5:30 PM. Jules will keep everyone posted so we stay in sync.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’m just waiting on the driver to confirm the pickup time, then I’ll text Pia. Quinn’s sending out a simple invite to the block too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — once the driver confirms, I’m happy to keep to the weekday 8:00 AM and 5:30 PM plan.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks — I’ll wait for Oren’s text with the pickup time and spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, sounds right — it’s still at 7:30 by the corner, as far as I know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah — I’ll keep an eye out for Oren’s text in case anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to confirm, we’re still doing the carpool at 7:30 AM, right? And it’s Dane, Mia, and me riding together?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, that sounds right — I’m just waiting on Vik to send the final details, and I’ll text Rey the pickup spot as soon as I have the time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll wait for your text, and we’re still set for 7:30 AM with Dane, Mia, and me, right?
